title: Africa CDC: DRC Ebola outbreak still not under control six months on
detail: Africa CDC's Jean Kaseya warned it could become the worst Ebola outbreak ever if not stopped now. Government data show over 11,200 cases and 5,500 deaths; over 80% of new cases arise outside contact lists and over 65% of deaths occur in the community. Only $1.3bn of $2.9bn pledged has been released. WHO's Tedros said transmission is slowing in several early epicentres.
